sections.heading: How We Shortlisted Ultralight Hiking Backpacks
body: This draft evaluates each pack by weight-conscious design, support structure, practical carry range, storage layout, category reputation, and likely fit for hikers who care about both efficiency and real trail usability.
Before publication, an editor should verify product-specific Amazon URLs, confirm affiliate links, and review any image references used in the package.

sections.heading: Buying Advice
body: The best ultralight backpack is not always the lightest one. Torso fit, back-panel comfort, pocket layout, load transfer, and practical carry range matter just as much as the headline weight.

Choose a more mainstream lightweight pack if comfort and versatility matter most. Choose a more specialized ultralight pack if aggressive weight savings are the top priority and you are comfortable with tradeoffs.
